title: Title Slide
description: First Nationwide Mortgage Bank — a complete digital rebuild.

title: The Starting Point
description: What existed before: a sparse Wix page with no forms, no admin tools, and no email notifications.

title: Project Goals
description: Four problems and their four solutions: polished web presence, online applications, email notifications, admin dashboard.

title: Tech Stack
description: Modern, type-safe stack: React + Vite, Express 5, PostgreSQL + Drizzle ORM, Zod, pnpm workspaces.

title: System Architecture
description: One monorepo, three layers: website artifact, API server artifact, and shared DB library.

title: The Website
description: Seven pages built from scratch in React: Home, About, Services, Blog, Contact, and two application pages.

title: Brand & Design
description: Navy primary, gold accent, diamond logo mark, Framer Motion animations, and a full shadcn/ui component system.

title: The Team
description: Pyramid layout on the About page: Edward Frish (President), Annabel R., and Gaudy R.

title: Loan Application Forms
description: Two forms built with react-hook-form + Zod — long-term mortgage and bridge loan, both POSTing to the API.

title: Database Layer
description: PostgreSQL via Replit, Drizzle ORM for full type safety, JSONB field for flexible form data.

title: Email Notifications
description: Gmail SMTP via Nodemailer sends a notification email on every new application submission.

title: Admin Dashboard
description: Password-protected /admin page with stats cards, searchable application table, and auto-refresh.

title: Admin API
description: Bearer-token-secured REST endpoint returning all applications newest-first.

title: Deployment
description: Live on Replit with autoscaling, isolated production/dev environments, and secure secrets.

title: Going Live
description: Two steps to replace 1stnmb.com: add the custom domain in Replit, then update DNS records.

title: Next Steps
description: Connect the domain, populate the blog, add analytics, and optional SMS notifications or client portal.
